criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: General Information Query
categories.definition: User asks for factual information, definitions, or general knowledge.

categories.name: Personal Information Query
categories.definition: User asks for information specific to their accounts, status, or personal data.

categories.name: Assistant Self-Information Query
categories.definition: User asks questions about the assistant's identity, capabilities, or status.

categories.name: Navigation & Location
categories.definition: User asks for directions, location of places, or their own current location.

categories.name: Calculations & Conversions
categories.definition: User requests mathematical calculations or unit/currency conversions.

categories.name: Device & Settings Control
categories.definition: User requests to change assistant or device settings, or control device functions.

categories.name: Reminders & Alarms
categories.definition: User requests to set, modify, or query alarms, timers, or reminders.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: User requests to send messages or make calls.

categories.name: Shopping & Ordering
categories.definition: User requests to purchase, order, or find products/services for purchase.

categories.name: Financial Account Action
categories.definition: User requests direct actions on their financial accounts, cards, or transactions.

categories.name: Media Playback & Management
categories.definition: User requests to play, add, or manage media content.

categories.name: Task & List Management
categories.definition: User requests to manage personal tasks or lists.

categories.name: Creative & Generative Tasks
categories.definition: User requests the assistant to create, generate, or compile new content or plans.

categories.name: Problem Solving & How-to
categories.definition: User asks for instructions, advice, or solutions to a problem.

categories.name: System Reset & Maintenance
categories.definition: User requests to reset or perform maintenance on the assistant or a linked device.

categories.name: Search & Discovery
categories.definition: User requests to find specific items, services, or information from a broad search.

categories.name: Scheduling & Booking
categories.definition: User requests to schedule appointments, book travel, or reserve resources.

categories.name: Environmental & Smart Home Control
categories.definition: User requests to control smart home devices or environmental settings.

categories.name: Weather Query
categories.definition: User asks for current or forecasted weather information.

categories.name: Clarification & Correction
categories.definition: User asks the assistant to repeat, clarify, or cancel a previous request.

categories.name: Utility Function
categories.definition: User requests the assistant to perform a simple, often random or specific, utility task.
